problem_description: Use-after-free of the listening socket's inpcb in the TCP SYN cache. In syn_cache_get(), the resetandabort error path stores the listen inpcb in both listeninp and inp, so the in_pcbunref(inp) call frees the listen socket that is still referenced through listeninp.

Page queue lock recursion in uvn_get(). uvm_pagefree() now acquires uvm_pageqlock internally, but the error path in uvn_get() still wraps its uvm_pagefree() call in uvm_lock_pageq()/uvm_unlock_pageq(), so that path recurses on the lock and panics.

NULL pointer dereference in nd6_rtrequest(). Iterator entries linked on nd6_list by the lockless llinfo traversal have ln_rt == NULL; nd6_rtrequest() takes TAILQ_LAST(&nd6_list) and moves it to the head to advance the LRU without checking for one, so it dereferences a NULL route.

NULL pointer dereference in uvmpd_scan(). The page list iterator is inserted with TAILQ_INSERT_AFTER() using the result of TAILQ_FIRST() without checking it for NULL, so an empty page list makes the insertion dereference a NULL page.

Lock recursion on if_maddrlock. in_addmulti() takes if_maddrlock and then calls igmp_joingroup(), igmp_sendpkt() and ip_output(), where in_hasmulti() takes the same lock again. mld6_sendpkt() recurses the same way for IPv6.
